title: Tribunal: source-bound audit to completed follow-up
subtitle: An opt-in review route, not a required gate. Candidate findings, verification, report and completion are distinct.

nodes.title: /tribunal · deliberate audit
nodes.body:
Resolve scope and trusted bundle
Inspect matching run directories
No source text grants execution

nodes.title: Check source-bound status
nodes.body:
Same source: audit or follow-up
Drift / unbound / invalid: no reuse
Terminal or new scope: fresh run

nodes.title: Inventory → profiles → cost
nodes.body:
Mechanical facts before model work
Bound concrete evidence inputs
User acknowledges cost + settings

nodes.title: Allocate a fresh bound run
nodes.body:
start returns run_id + run_dir
Persist source.json before reviews
Record actual budget and capacity

nodes.title: Retain history; do not relabel
nodes.body:
Changed evidence needs a fresh binding.
A deliberate abort records run-aborted.

nodes.title: Unchanged-source resume
nodes.body:
audit → unfinished recorded waves
follow-up → pending dispositions only

nodes.title: Inventory ≠ risk judgment
nodes.body:
inventory.json + readable projection
Risk map adds contract judgment
Optional mappers answer only gaps
No repository scripts run by discovery

nodes.title: Applicability + bounded packets
nodes.body:
Account for every lens card
Declare finding/evidence scopes
Only bound evidence may expand
Recheck source before dispatch

nodes.title: Generic reviewer · MODE review
nodes.body:
One assignment per active lens
At most 5 concurrent; host-bounded
Own findings / pending-leads files
No child dispatch or shared-log edits

nodes.title: Persist and account for output
nodes.body:
Import leads through the helper
Coordinator records actual events
Check source before accepting output
Missing output remains incomplete

nodes.title: Root-cause triage candidates
nodes.body:
Preserve provenance and old keys
Calibrate severity + confidence
Retain serious counterarguments

nodes.title: Fresh reviewer · MODE verify
nodes.body:
All serious / promoted serious claims
Expensive inferential recommendations
Attempt disproof with needed evidence

nodes.title: Eligibility + confidence gate
nodes.body:
Independent confirmed / narrowed
Keep only the supported surviving claim
Helper refusal cannot be log-edited away

nodes.title: Eligible phase plan
nodes.body:
keep / combine only
Preserve narrowed claims
Emit wave-triaged after plan

nodes.title: Refuted
nodes.body:
Preserve result and rationale
Not a confirmed issue
Not kept repair work

nodes.title: Inconclusive / shared context
nodes.body:
Record verify-required
Keep investigation work separate
Do not invent independent confirmation

nodes.title: Genuine design fork
nodes.body:
decision-required, not a disguised
factual uncertainty or automatic ADR
Leads need explicit dispositions

nodes.title: Report + manifest projections
nodes.body:
Source binding + actual coverage
Supported work and unresolved claims
Lead and follow-up dispositions
report-written → follow-up

nodes.title: Issue filing disposition
nodes.body:
Dedup against actual existing / partial receipts
Default: show selected eligible issue commands
Execute only with explicit filing authorization
issues-filed OR explicit filing-skipped

nodes.title: Separate optional public telemetry
nodes.body:
Preview the full bounded aggregate payload
No code / paths / source hashes / finding text
Explicit per-run consent before sending
telemetry-sent OR explicit telemetry-skipped

nodes.title: Unanswered or failed follow-up
nodes.body:
Keep pending; preserve real partial receipts
On resume, check current source again
Do not rerun completed lenses by default

nodes.title: Both dispositions resolved
nodes.body:
Filing done or explicitly skipped
Telemetry done or explicitly skipped
Source-bound follow-up rules still apply

nodes.title: run-completed
nodes.body:
Terminal signal, not just a written report
Audit history stays durable
No automatic repair, commit, merge or release

nodes.title: Account for every outcome
nodes.body:
Eligible work + unsupported claims
Verification / design / investigations
All leads have explicit dispositions
nodes.detail: Account for every finding and lead. The report includes eligible plans and unsupported, refuted or unresolved claims in separately labeled sections. Repeat review/triage for each recorded wave; report after the complete recorded scope is accounted for. A no-kept-work wave still has an explicit plan projection.

panels.title: 01  /  BIND THE RUN BEFORE DISPATCH
panels.caption: Declared finding scope is not the evidence scope. Source identity, not age, governs reuse.

panels.title: 02  /  SELECT EVIDENCE AND REVIEW THE APPLICABLE LENSES
panels.caption: The card inventory is the thirteen-lens roster. Skip rationale and coverage limitations remain visible.

panels.title: 03  /  VERIFY SERIOUS CLAIMS BEFORE KEEPING WORK
panels.caption: A fresh MODE verify assignment is an attempted disproof. Its actual independence and result still matter.

panels.title: 04  /  WRITE THE REPORT, THEN RESOLVE FOLLOW-UPS
panels.caption: report-written enters follow-up. It neither files issues nor ends the run.

panels.title: 05  /  COMPLETE ONLY AFTER BOTH DISPOSITIONS
panels.caption: Source checks remain applicable. Explicit skipping is different from an unanswered question or failed action.

notes.text: Resume by source binding; follow-up resumes at panel 04. Long return paths are reading aids, not additional command invocations.
Source contract and helper states inspected. No new model-backed audit, installed-host certification or accuracy claim is made here.
